# One&Only (One and Only Furniture) — oando.co.in

> One&Only, also searched as One and Only Furniture / One and Only Patna, supplies premium ergonomic office furniture for modern workplaces across India. Planning-led workstations, seating, storage, tables, and soft seating for commercial projects nationwide. HQ and showroom in Patna (Jagat Trade Centre, Frazer Road).

## Brand aliases (same company)

- One&Only
- One and Only
- One & Only
- One and Only Furniture
- One and Only Furniture Private Limited
- One and Only Patna
- One and Only Furniture Patna
- Oando / oando.co.in
